sections.title: II. Read the following passage and answer the questions. (1.25 points)
sections.introHtml: “Do more exercises to be healthier!” says the doctor. Everyone knows that doing exercise is good for the health. First of all, doing exercises burns calories and it helps you lose weight. You can go to the gym to work out, or you can play sports with your friends. You can sleep better if you act a lot during daytime. Moreover, regular exercise allows your blood to flow smoothly, so you can avoid heart disease. Besides, you need to pay attention to your daily meals. Drink more water and avoid alcohol. You should eat healthy food to have enough energy, but you shouldn't eat too much. It is important that you have time to relax after long working hours. Lastly, never forget to visit the doctor regularly to check your health condition.

questions.html:
1. Does doing exercises help you lose weight?
→ _______________________________
questions.referenceHtml:
1. Does doing exercises help you lose weight?
→ Yes, it does.

questions.html:

→ _______________________________
answers: You can go to the gym
questions.referenceHtml:

questions.html:
3. Can regular exercises help you avoid heart disease?
→ _______________________________
questions.referenceHtml:
3. Can regular exercises help you avoid heart disease?
→ Yes, they can.

questions.html:

→ _______________________________
questions.referenceHtml:

questions.html:
5. How often should you visit the doctor?
→ _______________________________
answers: You should visit the doctor regularly
